info.name: Chargetrip GraphQL API
info.description: GraphQL POST examples for the Chargetrip EV routing API. All queries and mutations are HTTP POST to https://api.chargetrip.io/graphql with x-client-id and x-app-id headers. Real-time route updates use GraphQL subscriptions over WebSocket at wss://api.chargetrip.io/subscription.

items.docs: Creates a route and returns a route id. Fetch with the route query or subscribe to routeUpdatedById over WebSocket.

body.data: {"operationName":"route","query":"query route($id: ID!) { route(id: $id) { status route { distance duration charges } } }","variables":{"id":"5f2e1a9c7d4b3e0012abcd34"}}

items.docs: Fetches a previously created route by id.

body.data: {"operationName":"stationAround","query":"query stationAround($query: StationAroundQuery!) { stationAround(query: $query, size: 20, page: 0) { id name status coordinates { latitude longitude } } }","variables":{"query":{"location":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[4.8951,52.3702]},"distance":5000}}}

items.docs: Fetches the closest stations around a GeoJSON location.

body.data: {"operationName":"station","query":"query station($id: ID!) { station(id: $id) { id name status evses { status connectors { standard power } } } }","variables":{"id":"5cd5e768e0d2cf001235f342"}}

items.docs: Fetches a single charge station by id.

body.data: {"operationName":"vehicleList","query":"query vehicleList($search: String, $page: Int, $size: Int) { vehicleList(search: $search, page: $page, size: $size) { id naming { make model version } battery { usable_kwh full_kwh } } }","variables":{"search":"Tesla","page":0,"size":10}}

items.docs: Lists EV vehicles with pagination, filter, and search.
Creates a reachability isoline and returns an isoline id.

body.data: {"operationName":"isoline","query":"query isoline($id: ID!) { isoline(id: $id) { status polygons maxDrivableDistance } }","variables":{"id":"5f2e1a9c7d4b3e0012abef56"}}

items.docs: Fetches a previously created isoline by id.

body.data: {"operationName":"operatorList","query":"query operatorList($page: Int, $size: Int) { operatorList(page: $page, size: $size) { id name } }","variables":{"page":0,"size":20}}
